summary: track_people on one clip with one backend: Grounding-DINO + SAM2 (the default) or SAM 3 (opt-in).
description: #1397 stage B (#1405): the A/B of track_people's two backends. 'video' is the fixture clip, 'backend' the arm (grounding-dino or sam3) and 'threshold' that backend's detection score floor, set explicitly so the record names it (DINO's scale and SAM 3's differ: 0.3 and 0.5 are their defaults). The step writes person-1..N mask videos (white is that person, the source's frame count and size), a numbered contact sheet with one tile per cut and, on sam3, one per late entrant at the frame it first appears, and the people record (first_frame per person).
